name: SREBP-controlled cholesterol homeostasis, biosynthesis and reverse transport
rationale: All members concern cellular cholesterol/sterol balance; unlike LDL-receptor clearance and LXR-driven efflux neighbours, this theme carries SREBP signaling, cholesterol biosynthesis regulation and HDL/reverse transport.

name: Stromal fibroblast matrix with complement and myeloid chemoattraction
rationale: Members describe the fibroblast/stromal ECM and adhesion compartment; unlike KRAS/fibroblast-proliferation, endothelial IL-33 and collagen/EMT neighbours, it adds complement, TGF-beta1 production and macrophage/mast cell chemotaxis.

core: Type I interferon induction by cytosolic RNA sensing
name: RIG-I/MDA5-driven type I interferon induction and its restraint
rationale: Members cover RIG-I/MDA5, IRF3/IRF7 and ZBP1 sensing leading to IFN-alpha/beta production; unlike virus-response and TBK1/cGAS neighbours, it includes the negative regulators of RIG-I signaling and antiviral defense.

core: Lipid mediator synthesis and GPCR signaling
name: Leukotriene synthesis and lipid mediator GPCR signaling
rationale: Members span leukotriene, prostanoid and PAF mediator production and their GPCRs; unlike prostaglandin/COX, lipoxin/eicosanoid catabolism and histamine neighbours, the theme centres on cysteinyl leukotriene synthesis and receptors.

name: Neuronal Ig-family adhesion in nodal assembly and dendrite self-avoidance
rationale: Members are L1-family, DSCAM, SDK and nectin adhesion interactions; unlike NCAM/L1 signaling, ephrin repulsion and myelination neighbours, it includes sodium channel clustering at nodes/paranodes and heterophilic adhesion for dendrite self-avoidance.

name: Ephrin and L1/NCAM signaling in axon fasciculation and neurite remodeling
rationale: Members combine ephrin repulsion and L1/CHL1/NCAM signaling in fasciculation, pruning and dendrite restraint; unlike heterophilic adhesion, netrin/RAC1 and Sema3A neighbours, it is defined by ephrin and L1/NCAM pathways.

core: Dendritic cell and T cell surface signatures
qualifier: T cell costimulation and DC differentiation
name: Dendritic cell surface signatures and T cell costimulation
rationale: Members are APC and T cell surface signatures plus regulation of DC differentiation and T cell costimulation/activation; unlike monocyte, B cell, NK/tolerance and MHC-II processing neighbours, it emphasizes DC-T cell contact.

qualifier: p53-driven, via BCL-2 proteins and apoptosome
name: p53-driven mitochondrial apoptosis through BCL-2 proteins and apoptosome
rationale: Members cover BH3-only/BAX/BAK activation, cytochrome c release, apoptosome and SMAC, and p53 transcriptional control of apoptosis; unlike p53 cell-cycle/senescence and execution-phase neighbours, it is the mitochondrial commitment step.

name: Interferon-stimulated gene effectors restricting viral replication
rationale: Members are IFN-alpha response signatures and ISG-mediated restriction of viral life cycle including ISG15; unlike RIG-I/IRF3 sensing neighbours and dengue-specific pathways, this is the downstream ISG effector arm.

name: Satellite cell maintenance restraining skeletal muscle development
rationale: Members concern negative regulation of muscle development and satellite cell maintenance/proliferation; unlike myoblast differentiation, fusion and atrophy neighbours, the focus is the muscle stem cell pool.

name: Mast cell differentiation, activation and degranulation control
rationale: All members regulate mast cell differentiation, activation, degranulation or histamine secretion; unlike FcepsilonRI signaling and Th2/eosinophil neighbours, it lacks receptor cascades and centres on mast cell control.

qualifier: IL-12/23, IL-10 and IL-15/IL-21 in NK cells
name: IL-12/23, IL-10 and IL-15 signaling in NK cell development
rationale: Members are IL-10, IL-12, IL-23, IL-15 and IL-21 signaling with NK cell proliferation/differentiation; unlike IL-27/35, type III IFN/NKT, IL-2/7 and TNF-inflammatory neighbours, it combines IL-12/23 and IL-10 with IL-15-driven NK biology.

qualifier: elastic fibre and collagen fibril organization
name: Elastic fiber and collagen fibril extracellular matrix assembly
rationale: Members are ECM signatures with elastic fibre assembly and collagen fibril organization; unlike collagen degradation/MMP, fibronectin-integrin and collagen biosynthesis neighbours, it emphasizes elastic fibre and fibril assembly.

name: Thymocyte proliferation, survival and selection in the thymus
rationale: All members regulate thymocyte proliferation, apoptosis, positive selection or differentiation; unlike bone marrow hematopoiesis and B/progenitor neighbours, the theme is thymus-specific.

qualifier: NAD salvage and nucleoside phosphate interconversion
name: NAD salvage and nucleoside phosphate interconversion
rationale: Members cover nicotinate/NAD(P) metabolism and nucleotide di/triphosphate interconversion; unlike CoA, creatine and mitochondrial ADP/ATP transport neighbours, it is defined by NAD salvage and nucleoside phosphate kinases.

name: Epithelial bicarbonate and anion exchange with aquaporin water transport
rationale: Members are bicarbonate, SLC26 anion and CFTR transport (and their disorders) plus aquaporin, paracellular and gap junction water/solute movement; unlike cation-chloride cotransporter, carbonic anhydrase and organic anion neighbours, it pairs anion exchange with water transport.

name: Injured axon regeneration and RHOA growth-inhibitory signaling
rationale: Members concern regeneration and sprouting of injured axons and the ceramide/RHOA growth-inhibition and growth-stimulation signaling; unlike collateral sprouting, Sema3A and glial myelination neighbours, it is injury-dependent.

name: Clathrin-mediated synaptic vesicle and postsynaptic receptor endocytosis
rationale: Members cover clathrin coat dynamics, synaptic vesicle endocytosis/recycling and postsynaptic receptor internalization; unlike presynaptic cytoskeleton, secretion and receptor delivery neighbours, it is defined by clathrin-dependent retrieval.

name: Neuropeptide and opioid signaling in stress and fear behavior
rationale: Members combine neuropeptide/opioid GPCR signaling and dense core vesicle release with stress, CRH, corticosterone and fear responses; unlike sleep/circadian and mating behaviour neighbours, the context is stress.

name: Neuronal fate specification in forebrain, retina and cerebellum
rationale: Members concern regional neuron and glia differentiation in forebrain, thalamus, retina, cerebellum and midbrain; unlike cortical migration/spinal and progenitor-division neighbours, it includes retinal and cerebellar cell fates.

Members mix RNA polymerase II initiation, ribosome assembly, inner cell mass proliferation, mitochondrial housekeeping, centrosome, RB1/BCL2L1, polycomb chromatin and ubiquitination modules with no single shared biological process.

qualifier: t6A and wobble modification for fidelity
name: tRNA aminoacylation and anticodon modification for translational fidelity
rationale: Members are cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNA aminoacylation and t6A/wobble anticodon modifications supporting translational fidelity; unlike hydroxylation/wybutosine, tRNA methylation/processing and mitochondrial translation neighbours, it adds t6A modification and fidelity.

qualifier: small GTPase prenylation and autophagy-linked lipidation
name: Small GTPase geranylgeranylation and autophagy-linked protein lipidation
rationale: Members cover RAB/RAS geranylgeranylation and processing, protein lipidation/delipidation and nucleophagy; unlike palmitoylation and Hedgehog/Wnt lipidation neighbours, it is prenylation plus delipidation and microautophagy.

name: Monocyte and resting dendritic cell surface signatures
rationale: All members are monocyte or dendritic cell surface/receptor signatures; unlike T/plasma cell and activated-DC neighbours and monocyte differentiation/antigen presentation neighbours, it is restricted to monocyte and resting DC surface markers.

name: FGF receptor phospholipase C signaling cascade
rationale: All three members are the PLC-mediated cascade downstream of FGFR1, FGFR3 and FGFR4; unlike FRS-, SHC- and PI3K-branch neighbours, it is the PLC branch.
